column1: # visual-emissive.tsv — emissive-bake table (the gallery LIGHTMAP class, the dominant
# residual of the 99.46%-gated run 42085254497: ours renders glowing/modded-lit blocks
# dim where the real client renders them fullbright).
# stateId<TAB>level<TAB>evidence — level 0-15; the GalleryPack composite emit sets
# element "light_emission" = level on EVERY element of the emitted model JSON
# (1.21.2+ block-model element property, purely visual). Absent file = empty table =
# today's behavior byte-for-byte (mirror of the visual-tints.tsv contract).
# SEEDING: every row is a MEASURED RED row in run 42085254497's join-*.json for a block
# whose mod code registers an emissive mechanism (BOP 21.1.0.14 ModBlocks.java; none
# guessed from names). Pixel evidence (truth/ours crops, run 42085254497): on the
# glowing pixels ours renders at 0.43-0.77x of truth while truth renders at ~1.08-1.11x
# the raw mod texture — FULLBRIGHT — so level=15 (the measured truth brightness) for
# every row, NOT the mod's code lightLevel (recorded per family below; the code value
# sets the block's world emission in truth, and grid-neighbor spill lights the
# lit=false cells of the dense gallery scene to the same fullbright).
#   lumaloop                bop code lightLevel LIT?10:0 (LumaloopBlock.java lightLevel(10))
# EXCLUDED (honest negatives): create:refined_radiance — its measured RED is ITEM-channel
# only (join-item-create-p6, n=63497); the create walk never emitted a block-state row,
# so the block-composite bake cannot reach it (an item-channel surface is a separate lever).
# GREEN-but-near-gate siblings sharing the dimness signature stay out of the table
